1020-2034-7714.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {2}.
When Myr Retriever enters, Ultron triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning an artifact card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ultron trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Myr Retriever.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Myr Retriever token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Myr Retriever token dies, it triggers, returning the nontoken Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

215-1129-3480.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Allies.
215-1129-3480.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Harabaz Druid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Harabaz Druid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-2762-6972.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Thopter Squadron.
When Thopter Squadron dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Thopter Squadron enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

856-5231-5776-7396.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius, History Chaser trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

149-7124.description:
Cast Legolas's Quick Reflexes by paying {G}, targeting The Incredible Hulk.
Declare The Incredible Hulk as an attacker, tapping him in the process.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, dealing damage equal to its power to itself.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and then untapping it and causing you to gain an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.
149-7124.notes: The Incredible Hulk cannot have vigilance to ensure it taps during the declare attackers step.

2275-3532-4668-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Shabraz triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3918-4824-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that share a creature type.
3918-4824-7013.description:
Activate Trazyn using White Lotus Tile's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Trazyn using Soliton's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1850-4935-5413.description:
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-4935-5413.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-5173-5258-5618-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Shambling Ghast from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, exiling Shambling Ghast from the top of your library with the ability to cast it until your next turn.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Cast Shambling Ghast from exile by paying {1}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.

4693-5531-6621-6763.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
4693-5531-6621-6763.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Repeat.

413-1445-4871-5477.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
413-1445-4871-5477.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-1887-4636-5770.description:
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating three 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers three times, causing you to get twelve {E}.
Repeat.

3490-5231-5532.easyPrerequisites: "Legion" chosen with Battle of Hoover Dam.
3490-5231-5532.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures.
3490-5231-5532.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing another creature, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Battle of Hoover Dam triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1409-2691-3499.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Ilysian Caryatid.
1409-2691-3499.description:
Activate Ilysian Caryatid by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Ilysian Caryatid by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Ilysian Caryatid enters the battlefield, Deadeye Navigator's soulbound ability triggers, repairing it and Ilysian Caryatid.
Repeat.

1114-1124-1414-4450.description:
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing an extra activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Cast Wrenn and Realmbreaker by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Activate Wrenn and Realmbreaker's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing a land you control to become a 3/3 Elemental in addition to its other types.
Activate Wrenn and Realmbreaker's third loyalty ability by removing six loyalty counters from it.
Wrenn and Realmbreaker dies as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Wrenn and Realmbreaker ability, causing you to get an emblem.
 Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 7.

3253-4050-4153-4365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least six permanents.
Myojin of Blooming Dawn has at least one indestructible counter on it.
3253-4050-4153-4365.description:
Activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, causing you to create two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens for each permanent you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar eight times by sacrificing eight Spirits, adding {5}{W}{W}{W}.
Activate Mondrak by paying {1}{W}{W} and sacrificing two Spirits, putting an indestructible counter on it.
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, moving an indestructible counter from Mondrak onto Myojin.
Repeat.

1054-3765-4838.description:
Cast Dragon's Approach by paying {2}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to one.
Resolve Dragon's Approach, dealing 3 damage to each opponent.
Each opponent loses the game due to having less than zero life.

1308-3899-4871.notablePrerequisites: Spawning Pit has at least two charge counters.
1308-3899-4871.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two 2/2 Spawn artifact creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing both Spawns.
The Spawns die, triggering Pitiless Plunderer twice, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Spawning Pit abilities, putting two charge counters on it.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

678-1182.description:
Cast Stonecoil Serpent by paying {0}.
Stonecoil Serpent enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Stonecoil Serpent from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
